note: Documented cross-sectional effects, oldest-queued first. The factory takes the first entry whose status is queued and that no factory ledger run has declared yet (analysis/cross_section_queue.py). An entry is never edited after it is run: a change is a new version. stated_effect.checked says how the size was checked: paper = read in the paper itself; secondary = a summary or abstract record named in source; not_checked = from memory, to be read before anything is compared with it.

paper.title: Evidence of Predictable Behavior of Security Returns

stated_effect.text: extreme-decile spread of abnormal returns 2.49 % a month (losers over winners on last month's return)

entries.mechanism: liquidity provision: last month's heavy sellers or buyers push prices past value and the price comes back
entries.deviation: held one session close to close and re-ranked nightly, not held a month; S&P 500 members only

paper.authors: Tobias J. Moskowitz and Mark Grinblatt
paper.title: Do Industries Explain Momentum?

entries.paper_sample: CRSP stocks in 20 industries, 1963-1995 (secondary; not read in the paper)

stated_effect.text: buying past winning industries and selling past losing ones is highly profitable and explains much of stock momentum; no size taken yet

entries.mechanism: news diffuses slowly across firms of an industry, so an industry's past return keeps going
entries.deviation: 11 GICS sectors stand in for the paper's 20 industries; six-month formation; one-session holds re-ranked nightly

paper.authors: Thomas J. George and Chuan-Yang Hwang
paper.title: The 52-Week High and Momentum Investing

entries.paper_sample: CRSP stocks, 1963-2001 (secondary; not read in the paper)

stated_effect.text: about 0.45 % a month for the top 30 % against the bottom 30 % on price over 52-week high

entries.mechanism: anchoring: investors under-react to news that takes a price near or far from its 52-week high
entries.deviation: one-session holds re-ranked nightly; the paper holds six months

entries.paper_sample: NYSE and AMEX stocks, weekly (period not read in the paper)
